title: electioneering_communication
description: One electioneering communication for one candidate: a broadcast ad naming a candidate shortly before an election, paid for by a spender filing the FEC's Form 9, from the FEC's electioneering communications file (from 2010). A disbursement naming several candidates is one row per candidate, each with the FEC's equal share in `amount`: sum `amount`, never `disbursement_amount`. A row has no side: the filing does not say whether the ad is for or against the candidate. The file shows no amendment, so a report a later one restates may be counted twice. Outside spending, never a contribution: never add it to `contribution` or any other receipt amount. Partitioned by cycle.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year.

source.description: Where the row comes from. `fec` for every row of v1.

source_record_id.description: The row's id, unique within a source: `<image_num>:<n>`, n the row's place among its image number's rows in this table, ordered by every column as filed. The file has no id of its own.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

committee_id.description: The FEC id of the spender: a person or group filing as a committee (a non-committee spender, told by `committee.type`), or a committee.

candidate_id.description: The FEC id of the candidate the row names, when they are a candidate of the cycle, else null: an ad about an issue may name none. A second id the same person holds for the race is replaced by the one holding their money, and a row naming a candidate whose committee was handed to another (Biden's 2024 campaign, Harris's from 2024-07-21), dated on or after the handoff or undated, is the second candidate's.

race_id.description: That candidate's race, the `race` table's key; null when there is none.

amount.description: The candidate's share of the disbursement in dollars, as the FEC calculated it: the disbursement divided equally among the candidates it names. Sum this.

disbursement_amount.description: The whole disbursement in dollars, as reported, repeated on each of its rows. Never sum it.

candidate_count.description: The number of candidates the disbursement names, as reported.

date.description: The date of the disbursement as reported; null when the filer gave none.

communication_date.description: The date of the communication as reported.

public_distribution_date.description: The date the communication was first publicly distributed, as reported.

payee_name.description: Whom the spender paid, as reported.

description.description: What the spender paid for, as reported.

image_num.description: The FEC image number of the page the row is on.
